title: Add turn-heavy command sampling and a gate-off option to the yaw-gate experiment
summary: The experimental task in locomotion.task_v4_yaw_gate gains turn_draw_fraction, which turns that share of the moving command draws into a turn in place at 0.2 rad/s with a random sign, and yaw_gate_on=none, which switches the yaw gate off. The bank holds two turns in place among twenty moving commands, so a policy otherwise practises a pure turn on one draw in ten. The default draws nothing extra from the task's generator, so earlier runs keep their command sequences.
next: Train turn-heavy sampling alone and with the turn-only gate on the surrogate and compare turn rate, translation speed and stopping with the v4 control.
reason: Opt-in options of an experimental task change no native result, gate or default reward.
